rdfs:label: mediaType
rdfs:comment: The IANA MIME media type (e.g. `text/html`, `image/png`): on an Object, the type of its `content` value; on a Link, the type of the resource at `href`.
notes: ActivityStreams' content-type label — typically attached to an Object to declare the format of its `as:content` (HTML vs plain text vs Markdown), or to a Link/attachment. Unlike `urn:solid:format` (dcterms:format, which may be a MediaTypeOrExtent resource or describe physical medium/dimensions), `mediaType` is a single plain-string MIME type. Not `dcat:mediaType`, which is DCAT's distribution media type and takes an IANA media-type IRI.

examples.title: Note with explicit content media type

history.note: Comment clarified (type of content on Object, of href target on Link); notes no longer equate it with dcterms:format.
